page_title: Researching UK Non-Executive Director Board Opportunities
primary_keywords: UK non-executive director board opportunity research

keyword_metrics.source: No Search Console, Google Keyword Planner, or validated third-party keyword export was supplied for this candidate.
keyword_metrics.note: Search terms are hypotheses only; no volume, difficulty, or demand is asserted.

search_intent.primary_query: UK non-executive director board opportunity research
search_intent.intent: Unmeasured candidate-information hypothesis: use UK-listed-company governance disclosures to research board composition and understand appointment-process disclosures without inferring a live vacancy.
evidence: The UK Corporate Governance Code 2024 discusses board skills and composition, nomination committee succession responsibilities, and open advertising and/or external search consultancy for chair and NED appointments.

intended_audience: Experienced executives and directors researching UK non-executive director opportunities.
geographic_relevance: United Kingdom governance context only; not a universal rule for all boards or jurisdictions.

competitor_research.name: UK-localized candidate-facing board appointment research guides
competitor_research.finding: A current UK-localized SERP and direct competitor review was not completed.

commercial_relevance: Potential candidate research resource only if a distinct user need, demand, overlap and KOV serviceability are later established. The FRC Code does not establish KOV search mandates or commercial value.
unique_content_purpose: Help candidates interpret publicly disclosed UK board composition, nomination and succession information while distinguishing governance disclosures from a live appointment opportunity.
duplication_and_cannibalisation_assessme: The existing board-CV guide concerns candidate materials, and the NED due-diligence guide concerns evaluating a specific opportunity. This candidate focuses on using public governance disclosures to research composition and appointment processes; full page-level overlap remains pending.

authoritative_sources.title: UK Corporate Governance Code 2024
authoritative_sources.research_use_and_limit: Used for board skills and composition (Principle K), nomination committee/succession (Provision 17), open advertising and/or search consultancy for chair and NED appointments (Provision 20), and board review/development (Provisions 21-22). UK governance guidance only; not a vacancy listing, legal advice, or a guarantee of appointment.

content_status: Source-bounded UK NED opportunity research guide implemented in noindex staging. No live vacancy or appointment outcome is claimed.
remaining_gaps: Direct UK-localized SERP and competitor research.
First-party demand evidence and full current-site overlap review.
Recheck the current Code version and company-specific governance statements before any publication decision.
